uutiset.s: Indonesia’s rupiah — Asia’s worst-performing currency this year — has been under pressure since late 2024, as investors have grown increasingly concerned about the country’s fiscal outlook. uutiset.t: DayOne Is Said to Pause US IPO Plans on Data Center, Market Concerns
uutiset.s: DayOne Data Centers Ltd. has put plans for its multibillion-dollar US initial public offering on hold, people familiar with the matter said, as investors question the sustainability of frothy valuations for digital infrastructure supporting the artificial intelligence boom.

uutiset.t: Cambodia Sees Growth Risk as High US Rates Hit Economy
uutiset.s: National Bank of Cambodia Governor Chea Serey says her country faces pressure from elevated US rates, imported inflation and higher funding costs because of its dollarized economy. uutiset.t: Cyberattacks Drive Claims Surge at Japan Insurers
uutiset.s: Japan’s biggest property insurers are reporting a sharp jump in cyber insurance claims as artificial intelligence-driven attacks grow more sophisticated and hacking incidents surge nationwide.

uutiset.t: China Has Capacity, But Maybe Not the Will to Boost Fuel Exports
uutiset.s: China has the greatest ability to boost global fuel supplies after it agreed with the US and Russia to do so, although whether Beijing will follow through on the pledge is doubtful.

uutiset.t: Yen Outperforms G-10 Peers as Tech Selloff Fuels Haven Demand
uutiset.s: The yen led gains among Group of 10 currencies on Friday as investors sought havens amid a deepening selloff in technology stocks that has spilled into Asia trading.

uutiset.t: Treasuries Eye Longest Rally in Five Months on Haven Demand
uutiset.s: Treasuries are headed for their longest rally in almost five months, as mounting doubts over the artificial intelligence trade deepen a global stock selloff and drive investors toward haven assets.

uutiset.t: Pakistan Minister Makes Rare India Visit for Regional Forum
uutiset.s: Pakistan’s Climate Change Minister Musadik Malik arrived in New Delhi Friday for a two-day regional forum, the first such high-level visit since 2023, though it signals no broader thaw in ties between the neighbors.

uutiset.t: ARK Invest's Cathie Wood on Anthropic, Nvidia
uutiset.s: Cathie Wood, Founder, CEO & CIO at ARK Invest, discusses her exposure to Anthropic following the AI lab's historic IPO and her views on investing in innovation. She speaks on "ETF IQ Asia." (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: PBOC Anchors Yuan With Stable Fix as Volatility Jumps After APEC
uutiset.s: China’s central bank signaled it wants to curb sharp moves in the yuan with a largely steady fixing Friday, after the currency posted its biggest drop since March following a trilateral leaders’ meeting.

uutiset.t: AI Spurs Funding Needs as Top Japan Power Producer Weighs IPO
uutiset.s: Japan’s biggest electricity producer said the artificial intelligence boom is supporting the case for investment in the power sector as it considers ways to raise funds for expansion, including a possible initial public offering.

uutiset.t: Copper Rout Worsens as AI Selloff Wreaks Havoc in Metals Markets
uutiset.s: Copper sank to its lowest level since March after a week of market turmoil fueled by deepening worries about global demand.

uutiset.t: Honda Debuts Hybrid SUV for Asia in Pivot From Failed EV Bet
uutiset.s: Honda Motor Co. unwrapped a new flagship SUV, the first of a range of gas-electric hybrid models the company is rolling out this decade as part of its pivot away from fully electric cars.

uutiset.t: Rising Bond Yields May Pose a Challenge to Nifty’s Sharp Rebound
uutiset.s: The Nifty has rebounded almost 15% since early October, pushing valuations higher.
